Believers will see Allah on the Day of Resurrection as clearly as the sun and full moon, after each nation that worshipped other than Allah falls into Hell.
Looking at the full moon, the Prophet says believers will see their Lord as clearly, so they should not miss the prayers before sunrise and sunset.
Aisha says whoever claims Muhammad saw his Lord, knows tomorrow or concealed any revelation is a liar, citing verses, and that he saw Gabriel in his true form twice.
Looking at the full moon, the Prophet told those with him they will see their Lord as clearly, so they should not miss the prayers before sunrise and sunset.
Everyone's Lord will speak to him with no interpreter or screen, and in the Paradise of Eden only the Cover of Majesty over His Face keeps people from seeing Him.
